name: cmail
description: Open-source email platform on Cloudflare — Google/Microsoft SSO, D1, R2, Email Routing

scripts.deploy: pnpm run deploy:email-worker && pnpm run deploy:web
scripts.deploy:email-worker:preview: pnpm config:check && pnpm --filter @cmail/email-worker exec wrangler deploy --env preview
scripts.db:migrate: pnpm config:check && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config apps/web/wrangler.toml
scripts.db:migrate:local: pnpm config:check && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config apps/web/wrangler.toml
scripts.db:migrate:preview: pnpm config:check && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env preview --config apps/web/wrangler.toml
scripts.validate: pnpm secrets:scan && pnpm config:check && pnpm lint && pnpm check && pnpm test && pnpm db:migrate:verify && pnpm build && pnpm audit --audit-level=low
